observed_primitives: Module.register_forward_pre_hook can return modified positional input or modified args/kwargs
Module.register_forward_hook can return a modified module output
both return RemovableHandle for explicit hook removal
Module._call_impl bypasses hook machinery when no local/global hooks are present
hook order is explicit through prepend and local/global hook ordering

mapping.pytorch_native_shape: targeted module pre-hook or forward-hook returning a modified activation only for the declared intervention arm
mapping.f2_requirement: wrap the hook in an F2-owned adapter that binds probe_id, broadcast id/digest/generation, exact module path, hook kind, intervention transform digest, model/checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build identity, seed/determinism controls and raw downstream output digest

mapping.pytorch_native_shape: RemovableHandle.remove plus an unmodified control arm on the same exact module path
mapping.f2_requirement: verify the handle is removed and run a post-removal baseline-equivalence check; never infer removal from object lifetime alone

mapping.pytorch_native_shape: hooks can perturb/observe tensors but provide no GWT recipient semantics, no probe identity, no truth authority and no effect authority
mapping.f2_requirement: keep WP507 deterministic receipt/summary/causal-arm layer authoritative for contract-scope uptake; native-hook evidence is a separate model-internal measurement channel only

mapping.pytorch_native_shape: no separate interpretability framework is required if the exact local model runtime already depends on PyTorch
mapping.f2_requirement: do not claim dependency savings until exact model runtime is known; if the target is not PyTorch-native, this advantage disappears

risks_and_fences: Global module hooks add global state and are documented mainly for debugging/profiling; use specific-module hooks only.

Historical PyTorch issues show hooks and torch.compile have had compatibility/visibility edge cases; the E3 test must run against the exact target runtime/build and should prefer eager mode for the causal probe unless compiled-mode equivalence is separately proven.
Some submodules may not execute through the apparent Python module boundary; hook target presence must be proven by a no-op observation receipt before intervention.

Retaining activation tensors in hook closures can retain memory; capture only bounded detached digests/projections unless the experiment explicitly needs the tensor and then release it deterministically.
An activation difference is not semantic GWT uptake, world truth or effect evidence.
Exact checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build and consumed-model identity remain external prerequisites.

architecture_hypothesis.statement: For the first exact-model GWT/J-Space lesion-rescue falsifier, a thin F2-owned adapter over PyTorch specific-module forward/pre-forward hooks is likely lower-risk and lower-resource than importing full TransformerLens or pyvene, provided the exact ~0.8B target is already executed through a compatible PyTorch eager module path.
architecture_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: The exact target may use a compiled/fused execution path where Python module hooks are incomplete, perturb execution semantics, or add enough overhead/identity ambiguity that a dedicated intervention framework such as TransformerLens/pyvene/NNsight is safer and more reproducible.
architecture_hypothesis.why_this_is_nonduplicate: Existing Trigger-6 lanes audited full intervention/tracing frameworks; this result isolates the zero/near-zero-extra-dependency native primitive explicitly recommended as the comparator in the TransformerLens E1/E2 work.

next_gate.cheap_discriminator: On the exact intended local model runtime/build, bind one module path; run baseline, no-op-hook baseline, one declared activation lesion/rescue, remove hook, then post-removal baseline. Require target hook firing, exact non-intervention input identity, bounded raw-output digest receipt, post-removal equivalence and zero F2 state/effect writes.
next_gate.prefer: eager execution for first falsifier unless compiled-mode hook equivalence is already exact-source tested
next_gate.promotion_rule: Only if this E3 discriminator passes should Trigger-6 consider an E4 F2 ablation against TransformerLens/pyvene; no E5 build candidate from E2 alone.
